newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marsteel up sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Marsteel up sharply in late trade.

text.p: Marsteel Consolidated Inc A and B shares rose by 1.30 centavos each in late trade on Monday as investors resumed focus on tertiary issues while taking profits in big-cap counters, brokers said.
The A shares of the holding firm jumped by 43.33 percent to 4.30 centavos while its B shares climbed by 41.94 percent to 4.40 centavos late in the session.

"The main index is down and we see a shift of funds again from the blue chips to the penny issues. As of now, the market does not know of any new stories on these counters," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.
A total of 46.10 million Marsteel A shares and 46.30 million B shares changed hands minutes before the close of the session.
Early last week, Marsteel and other thirdliners had gained points as most blue chips tumbled.
